faq.description: Clear answers about guest availability, image models, EzPic Credits, private media, billing, and responsible use.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

restrictions.question: What does “AI image editor with prompt no restrictions” mean on EzPic?
restrictions.answer: It means flexible prompt editing instead of a fixed template list. Describe what to preserve and what to change, keep your images private, and review credits before confirming. Content safety checks, legal requirements, model capabilities, and plan limits still apply; it does not mean uncensored or unlimited free generation.

guestAvailability.question: When is the guest edit available?
guestAvailability.answer: When the sponsored guest queue is available, a visitor can start one Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K edit without an account. The result is watermarked, private, and available for up to 24 hours.

guestVsFree.question: What is the difference between Guest and Free?
guestVsFree.answer: Guest is a conditional, one-time sponsored Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K edit with a watermarked result kept for up to 24 hours. A registered Free account receives 25 EzPic Credits each month; Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K costs 5, so that is up to five edits. GPT Image 2 and Seedream 5 Pro require a paid plan.

editTiers.question: Which image models and output settings are available?
editTiers.answer: Explore GPT Image, Nano Banana, and Seedream models. Each model page includes creative directions and prompts. The workspace shows current availability, output settings, and credits before you confirm a generation. Each confirmed generation produces one image.

creditReservation.question: When are credits used?
creditReservation.answer: For account edits, credits are reserved when you confirm the job. The immutable credit ledger charges or returns them when the job reaches its final state; if service acceptance is uncertain, the reservation stays in place until recovery settles the same attempt.

failedEdits.question: What happens to credits when an edit fails?
failedEdits.answer: Technical failures with no usable result release the reserved credits. If a generated image is blocked by content safety, each account or team gets one lifetime waiver; later blocked results are charged at the quoted amount. Rejected prompts or uploads do not use this waiver. Uncertain outcomes keep credits reserved until recovery resolves them.

privateUploads.question: Are uploaded images public?
privateUploads.answer: No. Guest and account inputs and outputs are private, not posted to a public gallery. The configured retention target for account inputs and outputs is 30 days. EzPic may send only the minimum content needed to configured infrastructure and image-processing services.

formats.question: Do I need to upload a reference image?
formats.answer: No. Sign in to generate from a text prompt with no reference. If you want to edit or guide an existing image, upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Guest reference uploads are limited to 10 MB; account upload limits are shown on the pricing page.

outputBehavior.question: Will every result be unique and exact?
outputBehavior.answer: No. Results can contain defects or resemble other images. EzPic does not guarantee uniqueness, fitness for a particular purpose, or freedom from third-party rights.

stableTiers.question: Why do image models use different EzPic Credit amounts?
stableTiers.answer: Each image model has its own legal output-setting matrix and EzPic Credit amount. EzPic shows the product name, supported settings, and exact charge; private service routing and operating costs stay on the server.

annualBilling.question: How does annual billing affect credits?
annualBilling.answer: Pro is $190 per year, Ultimate is $490, and Max is $790. EzPic Credits are still issued monthly—700 for Pro, 1,800 for Ultimate, and 3,000 for Max—and unused credits do not roll over.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: Open Billing to manage cancellation. When access changes depends on the actual status and end date reported for your subscription.

refundPolicy.question: How are refunds handled?
refundPolicy.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the payment terms, transaction status, and applicable law. Contact support for review; EzPic does not promise a refund where one does not apply.

commercialUse.question: Can I use edited images commercially?
commercialUse.answer: Before commercial use, you must have the rights to every input and independently check the applicable terms, law, and third-party rights. Guest results are temporary and watermarked; EzPic does not claim that any output is automatically cleared for commercial use.

mediterranean.title: Mediterranean quiet
mediterranean.prompt: Transform the room into a sunlit Mediterranean retreat with limewashed walls, warm oak furniture, soft linen textures, and olive accents. Preserve the original camera angle and architecture.
mediterranean.alt: Sunlit Mediterranean living room with limewashed walls and warm wood furniture

cobalt.title: Sculpted cobalt
cobalt.prompt: Replace the background with a sculptural sand-colored studio, add a shallow reflective water surface, and light the cobalt bottle with crisp directional sunlight. Keep the product shape and label area unchanged.
cobalt.alt: Cobalt glass bottle on a sculptural sand-colored pedestal

emerald.title: Emerald in the rain
emerald.prompt: Change only the jacket to deep emerald technical fabric with a soft satin sheen. Preserve the person, pose, clothing layers, wet street, and overcast city lighting.
emerald.alt: Fashion portrait of a person in an emerald jacket on a rain-darkened street

blueHour.title: Blue-hour cinema
blueHour.prompt: Relight the scene at deep blue hour with warm amber window glow, subtle wet-ground reflections, and restrained cinematic grain. Preserve all architecture, vehicle details, and framing.
blueHour.alt: Coastal motel and vintage convertible illuminated at blue hour

citrus.title: Citrus color story
citrus.prompt: Turn this dessert photo into a vibrant editorial composition with a lavender ceramic plate, coral linen, a deep plum surface, and sculpted window light. Keep the tart realistic and sharply detailed.
citrus.alt: Bright citrus tart on a lavender plate with coral linen

paperTrain.title: Paper-cut alpine
paperTrain.prompt: Reimagine the scene as handcrafted layered paper-cut art with visible paper fibers, precise dimensional shadows, alpine greens, a cobalt sky, and a tomato-red train. Preserve the route and mountain composition.
paperTrain.alt: Layered paper-cut illustration of a red train winding through alpine mountains

lunarGreenhouse.title: Midnight glasshouse
lunarGreenhouse.prompt: Relight the greenhouse under deep moonlight with translucent violet leaves, sparse bioluminescent flowers, and a trace of cool mist. Preserve the glass architecture, central path, and plant layout.
lunarGreenhouse.alt: Moonlit glasshouse filled with violet bioluminescent plants

porcelainTide.title: Porcelain tide
porcelainTide.prompt: Transform the ocean scene into hand-painted blue-and-white porcelain with fine crackle, sparing gold repair seams, and sculpted ceramic foam. Preserve the wave arc, lighthouse, and cliff composition.
porcelainTide.alt: Blue-and-white porcelain wave curling around a miniature lighthouse

tangerineCamera.title: Tangerine instant
tangerineCamera.prompt: Recolor the camera in saturated tangerine with brushed aluminum controls, set it on a translucent lavender plinth, and add crisp studio light. Preserve the product silhouette, lens, and control layout.
tangerineCamera.alt: Unbranded tangerine instant camera on a lavender acrylic plinth

velvetFox.title: Velvet fox
velvetFox.prompt: Place the fox on a sculptural violet velvet chair against a deep plum studio backdrop, with soft editorial light and warm rim highlights. Preserve natural anatomy, fur detail, and the alert expression.
velvetFox.alt: Red fox seated naturally on a violet velvet chair

origamiKoi.title: Paper koi
origamiKoi.prompt: Reimagine exactly two koi as translucent folded-paper sculptures gliding through a dark teal underwater garden. Keep the opposing curves, sparse plants, overhead light, and open negative space.
origamiKoi.alt: Two translucent folded-paper koi swimming through dark teal water

desertPool.title: Desert first light
desertPool.prompt: Relight the pool scene at first light with a dusty rose sky, long soft shadows, and turquoise reflections. Preserve the modernist house, pool geometry, mountains, and lone lounge chair.
desertPool.alt: Modern desert home and turquoise pool at a dusty rose sunrise
